hebrewText: מוֹלִיכָ֖/ם בַּ/תְּהֹמ֑וֹת כַּ/סּ֥וּס בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֖ר לֹ֥א יִכָּשֵֽׁלוּ

tokens.bdb: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] again, away, bear, bring, carry (away), come (away), depart, flow, [phrase] follow(-ing), get (away, hence, him), (cause to, made) go (away, -ing, -ne, one's way, out), grow, lead (forth), let down, march, prosper, [phrase] pursue, cause to run, spread, take away (-journey), vanish, (cause to) walk(-ing), wax, [idiom] be weak.

tokens.bdb: an abyss (as a surging mass of water), especially the deep (the main sea or the subterranean watersupply)
tokens.explanation: tehom — abismo, oceano primordial, profundezas das águas

tokens.bdb: a horse (as leaping); also a swallow (from its rapid flight)
a pasture (i.e. open field, whither cattle are driven); by implication, a desert; also speech (including its organs)
not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
tokens.kjv: [idiom] before, [phrase] or else, ere, [phrase] except, ig(-norant), much, less, nay, neither, never, no((-ne), -r, (-thing)), ([idiom] as though...,(can-), for) not (out of), of nought, otherwise, out of, [phrase] surely, [phrase] as truly as, [phrase] of a truth, [phrase] verily, for want, [phrase] whether, without.
tokens.explanation: lo — negação absoluta em hebraico: não, nunca, jamais

tokens.bdb: to totter or waver (through weakness of the legs, especially the ankle); by implication, to falter, stumble, faint or fall
tokens.kjv: bereave (from the margin), cast down, be decayed, (cause to) fail, (cause, make to) fall (down, -ing), feeble, be (the) ruin(-ed, of), (be) overthrown, (cause to) stumble, [idiom] utterly, be weak.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to totter or waver (through weakness of the legs
tokens.enLiteralWord: to totter or waver (through weakness of the legs
tokens.explanation: to totter or waver (through weakness of the legs
tokens.explanationEn: to totter or waver (through weakness of the legs
